newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends barely changed.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed on Friday because of a lack of market-moving factors, dealers said.
The local unit closed at T$27.489 against Thursday's T$27.490 close.
Turnover through dealers was a modest US$191.50 million.
Dealers expected the rate to continue hovering at the current level in the near future.
"I don't think there is anything that can upset the rate at this point," a dealer at a foreign bank said.
A T$27.48-50 range was seen for Saturday. -- K. Chen (5080815)
